abi.c_signature: void FT_GlyphSlot_AdjustWeight(FT_GlyphSlot slot, FT_Fixed xdelta, FT_Fixed ydelta)

metadata.source_behavior: C returns without status, ignores null slots and non-outline/non-bitmap formats, converts 16.16 Em deltas through size ppem to outline 26.6 strengths or bitmap pixel strengths, then mutates slot geometry, metrics, advances, bitmap bytes, and bitmap_top as applicable.
